# Third Party

Only the example layer consumes these dependencies. The core `cinerig` target
does not include or link them.

- `glad/`: OpenGL 3.3 core loader generated by glad 2.0.8 with no extensions.
  See `glad/LICENSE`.
- `stb/stb_easy_font.h`: public-domain single-header debug font used by the HUD.
  License text is embedded in the header.
